overview: Between the stair and the play you wrote down the one line. Follow it in your own boat, or swim. You did not write Gannet's three news under it. You did not sit to a dinner. Egeon is at two.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the one line and did not sit to eat.

assets.name: the writing-tables
assets.disposition: Wrote the boatman's line on the tables
